description: Rarely available for purchase, a large 3 bedroom / 2.5 bath South of the Blvd. beautiful top floor condo can be yours.  The open floor plan makes the home feel even larger than its 1,551 sq. ft.  With a remodeled kitchen, plantation shutters through out, replaced dual paned windows, brand new carpet, stone flooring, granite counters, remodeled bathrooms, a private balcony, and a walk in custom closet all make this a perfect turnkey opportunity.  The building offers numerous patio areas to relax, large pool and separate spa for enjoyment.  The buildings location is truly amazing.  The Encino Commons is almost at your doorstep.  This well maintained building is gated and also offers underground gated parking.  The condo has 3 underground parking spots that are right next to the elevator entry.  All the best dining & shopping are at your fingertips.
